evals.name: startup-brand-system-from-scratch
evals.prompt: Create a brand identity guide for 'Trellis', a bookkeeping app for independent restaurants (owner-operators, 1–3 locations, €49/month). Positioning: 'the bookkeeping app that speaks restaurant' — built by ex-restaurant owners. Personality: practical, warm, no-nonsense. No existing assets. Accessibility matters (used on phones in dim kitchens).
evals.expected_output: Full guide in the skill's output format: strategic foundation, proposed palette with hex codes and WCAG checks, typography with open-source fonts, imagery rules incl. AI policy, voice attributes with is/is-not, tone matrix, vocabulary pairs, copy standards, naming, touchpoint checklist, brand prompt pack, and open items (trademark/domain checks).
assertions: Includes a complete colour palette with hex codes labelled as proposals and at least one contrast/WCAG 2.2 AA consideration suited to dim environments
Voice has 3–4 attributes each with 'means' and 'is not', plus a tone matrix with 6+ contexts
Vocabulary list has 10+ use/avoid pairs tied to restaurant owners
Includes an AI usage / brand prompt pack section and names open items like trademark and domain checks
Typography uses licensed/open-source fonts with weights, scale and fallbacks

evals.name: voice-guide-for-ai-content
evals.prompt: Our content team uses AI tools and everything sounds generic. We're a cycling apparel brand — direct, dry humour, obsessed with fit. Give us a voice and tone guide plus something we can paste into our AI tools so output stays on-brand.
evals.expected_output: Voice attributes with is/is-not, tone matrix including social replies and customer support, vocabulary and banned words, sentence style, and a brand prompt pack (system-prompt-style text with good/bad examples and a review step).
assertions: Defines 3–4 voice attributes with boundaries that express 'direct, dry humour, fit-obsessed'
Provides a paste-ready brand prompt pack including vocabulary, banned words and good vs bad examples
Includes a review/disclosure step for AI-generated content
Tone matrix covers support, social replies and errors, not just marketing

evals.name: touchpoint-consistency-audit
evals.prompt: Our brand feels inconsistent. Website uses navy and a serif, Instagram posts are neon gradients with a sans, email signatures all differ, and our sales deck is a default template. Brand guide from 2019 says navy #0B2545, orange #F26419, font 'Lato'. Audit and tell us what to fix first.
evals.expected_output: Touchpoint audit table with pass/fail per channel against the 2019 guide, prioritized fixes (templates, tokens, deck master, signature), a decision point on whether to update the guide (neon gradients vs navy), and a distribution plan; uses the given hex codes rather than inventing new ones.
assertions: Audits at least 5 touchpoints with pass/fail against the stated guide
Uses the provided hex codes and font rather than proposing a new palette unasked, while flagging whether the guide itself needs refreshing
Prioritizes fixes (templates, tokens, deck, signatures) with an order and owners
Includes an accessibility check of the navy/orange pairing
